name: tiktok-shop-ads
description: TikTok Shop affiliate UGC ads — Taglish Ate Host narration, some silent hero clips, 60-75 s of content, honest product claims only.
language: Taglish — natural Filipino/English code-switching, spoken by the Ate Host, not translated word for word
voice: The Ate Host: warm, practical, slightly funny, talks like a friend who already tried it. Never hypes.
style_rules: Type is Ad. Every claim must come from the product listing or from the owner; list each one in the Fact sheet with where it came from. Never invent specs, results, prices, reviews or testimonials.
No health, income or result guarantees, no superlatives you cannot back up, no comparisons against named brands.

Open on a specific small irritation in daily Filipino life (heat, ants, tight space, rainy-season mess, a commute habit), not on the product name. The product enters as the answer at about 20-30% of the runtime.
Show before you tell: each benefit is a demonstration in a hero clip or a line the viewer can see happening, with at most 3-4 benefits in total.
Silent hero clips (hero: yes, voiceover: none) carry the product in action; vary them so no two show the same action or angle.
Finish with one clear next step in the platform's own words; ask the owner if unsure. Do not script the 2.5 s end card as a clip.
visual_rules: The product must look exactly like the listing photo in every clip: shape, colour, size against hands, logo, parts. Put the product's description from the listing in Look anchors and paste it verbatim wherever the product appears.
The Ate Host looks the same in every clip (face, hair, grey t-shirt, no jewellery); lock her descriptor in Look anchors.
Hands: five fingers, plausible grip, slow simple actions. Only the on-screen host speaks; bystanders keep lips closed; when the host is off-screen nobody on screen talks.
No text, subtitles, watermark or stray logos (only what is printed on the product itself).
End every visual prompt with: no subtitles, no on-screen text, no watermark.
idea_wells: Small daily irritations in Filipino homes and commutes that the product solves in one visible step
A before/after that can be shot truthfully in one continuous action
A tiny ritual or habit the viewer recognises, then a better way to do it
